_comment: Pin for the bundled coarse global base terrain (#474, #1199/#1202).
The bundle is produced RARELY (the source grids are annual at best) and consumed by EVERY
release, so it is built once by hand and published as a versioned release asset in its own
repository. tools/fetch_base_terrain.py reads this file, downloads the asset, verifies the
sha256 below, and stages base-terrain/ next to the binary.
To pin a newly published bundle: set repo/tag/asset/sha256/size_bytes, and record the source
grids it was built from in `sources` so the attribution shipped with it can be audited.
An empty `tag` means NO bundle is pinned yet: the fetch is skipped and the release ships with
the procedural horizon, exactly as every release to date has. This is a declared state, not a
silent one -- the fetcher says so on stdout and the release notes say so too.
sources: GEBCO_2024 Grid, sub-ice topo (GEBCO Compilation Group, doi:10.5285/1c44ce99-0a0d-5f4f-e063-7086abc0ea0f) -- 15 arc-second global grid, 86400x43200, resampled to 1 arc-minute (21600x10800) with `gdal_translate -outsize 25% 25% -r average` before tiling
